items.mainDefect: The reader thread is never joined, so the assertion can run before an exception from a read still in flight after deletedAll.set(true) has been recorded.

secondary.defect: Nothing guarantees the reader actually reads while the deletions happen, so the test can pass without testing anything, even if the null-handling fix is reverted.
The reader thread is not a daemon thread, so it could keep the JVM running.
